title: A measure with rectangle values σ(B)·Hⁿ(A ∩ V) is the image of (Hⁿ⌞V) ⊗ σ under addition
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim V = n, let p := V.starProjection and q := V^⊥.starProjection be the orthogonal projections of ℝ^P onto V and onto V^⊥, let σ be a Borel measure on ℝ^P with σ(ℝ^P ∖ V^⊥) = 0 and σ(K) < ∞ for every compact K, and let ν be a Borel measure on ℝ^P with ν({y : p y ∈ A, q y ∈ B}) = σ(B)·Hⁿ(A ∩ V) for all Borel A, B ⊆ ℝ^P (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Then ν(A) = ∫⁻_{t∈V} σ({y : t + y ∈ A}) dHⁿ(t) for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P (lower Lebesgue integral over V), i.e. ν is the image of (Hⁿ⌞V) ⊗ σ under (t, y) ↦ t + y.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → σ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → σ K < ∞) → (∀ A B : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → ν (V.starProjection ⁻¹' A ∩ Vᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' B) = σ B * μHE[n] (A ∩ (V : Set (Euclid P)))) → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫⁻ t in (V : Set (Euclid P)), σ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[n]
